_readme: First read of Bakersfield College's program maps (S345, SkyLantern). The registry (probe run 37198225537) records the college's mapper page and its link to programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu, not read. A web search (2026-10-08) found the same page (/academics/program-mapper.html), which says each program shows a term-by-term course plan; the product began as a Bakersfield College and Concentric Sky partnership. Every Program Mapper host read so far answered 403 (lesson 33), so the mapper gets one load; a refusal is the mapper service's and is not retried another way.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map: its own pages, a PDF, or only its Program Mapper.
questions.mapper_open: Whether the college's Program Mapper host answers the reader (one load), and how it lists programs and terms if it does.
